**No, greasy food does not help a hangover** once you already have one, and it can actually make your symptoms worse.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14kaOw3Lfe94IRS555F-6BDzZh0AtRqLWnY79QbQ_p1mE0xm7rNZiCPf-z7rVZ45AKWjjeuIeX0ywtTPSbi4K4YAO_6iMuCDxTG_b2uPHWwLZKCWUJ5eeSLJywna3tDl6sXENnXP4jIczTsi_EJFVqqF2L4YNQZOyhGb5zBeJ7zX2Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF15LTJ8aVne-62r13KxpzUo5egr0iMcHTKMa5iJ3GBWSc3UfY_XHsDBhDuIHi84XCybRh5qI47meuq-sKVg4Q-vIP2xXHiADvc5ij-LY6gnRno2Yvrf4XpY7V7-ztXA0yVuNUwHJHiKik-cpRLtzN6WZOYiD1V534D4b4rVDCtiwd5g1aRShiF0HEV4R2mPLhIzd-Wp9RQh8xgQ)

### Why It Doesn't Work

- **The alcohol is already absorbed.** Greasy food only helps slow down alcohol absorption if you eat it *before* or *while* drinking. By the next morning, the alcohol has already entered your bloodstream, so there is nothing left in your stomach to "soak up".[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX6jifbqJGkqTYwLt8C90688fgk7JpgXZk_q-frfImMgeid0zm7aksQ5qgOA5By8ojykwghfwt2w-UpvPWvdqJBpc82LcPceuPHn0m8EY2AUc1nUgQxdQ3K8hJqYnUXFh6Jeaed5Cu)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF15LTJ8aVne-62r13KxpzUo5egr0iMcHTKMa5iJ3GBWSc3UfY_XHsDBhDuIHi84XCybRh5qI47meuq-sKVg4Q-vIP2xXHiADvc5ij-LY6gnRno2Yvrf4XpY7V7-ztXA0yVuNUwHJHiKik-cpRLtzN6WZOYiD1V534D4b4rVDCtiwd5g1aRShiF0HEV4R2mPLhIzd-Wp9RQh8xgQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14kaOw3Lfe94IRS555F-6BDzZh0AtRqLWnY79QbQ_p1mE0xm7rNZiCPf-z7rVZ45AKWjjeuIeX0ywtTPSbi4K4YAO_6iMuCDxTG_b2uPHWwLZKCWUJ5eeSLJywna3tDl6sXENnXP4jIczTsi_EJFVqqF2L4YNQZOyhGb5zBeJ7zX2Q)
- **It irritates your stomach.** Heavy, high-fat meals take longer to digest and can trigger acid reflux, indigestion, or worse nausea on an already sensitive stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14kaOw3Lfe94IRS555F-6BDzZh0AtRqLWnY79QbQ_p1mE0xm7rNZiCPf-z7rVZ45AKWjjeuIeX0ywtTPSbi4K4YAO_6iMuCDxTG_b2uPHWwLZKCWUJ5eeSLJywna3tDl6sXENnXP4jIczTsi_EJFVqqF2L4YNQZOyhGb5zBeJ7zX2Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX6jifbqJGkqTYwLt8C90688fgk7JpgXZk_q-frfImMgeid0zm7aksQ5qgOA5By8ojykwghfwt2w-UpvPWvdqJBpc82LcPceuPHn0m8EY2AUc1nUgQxdQ3K8hJqYnUXFh6Jeaed5Cu)
- **It increases inflammation.** Processed meats and deep-fried foods promote inflammation and offer zero hydration, slowing down your body's natural recovery.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14kaOw3Lfe94IRS555F-6BDzZh0AtRqLWnY79QbQ_p1mE0xm7rNZiCPf-z7rVZ45AKWjjeuIeX0ywtTPSbi4K4YAO_6iMuCDxTG_b2uPHWwLZKCWUJ5eeSLJywna3tDl6sXENnXP4jIczTsi_EJFVqqF2L4YNQZOyhGb5zBeJ7zX2Q)

### Why You Crave It Anyway

Alcohol triggers the production of a brain chemical called **galanin** , which increases your appetite for fats. Combined with low blood sugar and a drop in electrolytes, your brain instinctively seeks out calorie-dense, salty foods for quick energy and comfort.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXo8seI-7NsBr2VF-Iqe4C0ExUslYC655H-hm2Ng4iogad2hfM7sm68jonqumT7S0OFuI6pZzEWc1DchGkYNMM8zLy9qmDt1QVbeXPuyK-YmrieRu7V8unQTVMDvdUjbSaHi60TG9yrgltwinMJSTn_tET7gU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF15LTJ8aVne-62r13KxpzUo5egr0iMcHTKMa5iJ3GBWSc3UfY_XHsDBhDuIHi84XCybRh5qI47meuq-sKVg4Q-vIP2xXHiADvc5ij-LY6gnRno2Yvrf4XpY7V7-ztXA0yVuNUwHJHiKik-cpRLtzN6WZOYiD1V534D4b4rVDCtiwd5g1aRShiF0HEV4R2mPLhIzd-Wp9RQh8xgQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1-L6XtgYvuPhsEmW6ajNWcTZyC9SOhgqs49veGL0pEpLDBtU9D16ZFC-KqM825Thy7FsYsSflNvu4mVpErXpv-GHlhOnr8kSDlMIG1J3LGEC54E4B3-LAnzv80A5BauMVtQZQGUWkjHWu-OAkU6plQgnlcytVeFX7DVDxUANDh2p265slf0-cXbsDJV6wXCDTGG4-cc9bA)

### What to Eat Instead
To actually ease hangover symptoms, focus on gentle foods and fluids:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF15LTJ8aVne-62r13KxpzUo5egr0iMcHTKMa5iJ3GBWSc3UfY_XHsDBhDuIHi84XCybRh5qI47meuq-sKVg4Q-vIP2xXHiADvc5ij-LY6gnRno2Yvrf4XpY7V7-ztXA0yVuNUwHJHiKik-cpRLtzN6WZOYiD1V534D4b4rVDCtiwd5g1aRShiF0HEV4R2mPLhIzd-Wp9RQh8xgQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14kaOw3Lfe94IRS555F-6BDzZh0AtRqLWnY79QbQ_p1mE0xm7rNZiCPf-z7rVZ45AKWjjeuIeX0ywtTPSbi4K4YAO_6iMuCDxTG_b2uPHWwLZKCWUJ5eeSLJywna3tDl6sXENnXP4jIczTsi_EJFVqqF2L4YNQZOyhGb5zBeJ7zX2Q)

- **Hydration and electrolytes.** Sip water, broth, or an oral rehydration solution to replace lost fluids and sodium.
- **Bland carbohydrates.** Toast, crackers, or oatmeal help stabilize low blood sugar without upsetting your stomach.
- **Potassium-rich foods.** Bananas and avocados help replenish depleted electrolytes.
- **Plain eggs.** Eggs are easy to digest and contain cysteine, an amino acid that helps your body break down alcohol byproducts.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14kaOw3Lfe94IRS555F-6BDzZh0AtRqLWnY79QbQ_p1mE0xm7rNZiCPf-z7rVZ45AKWjjeuIeX0ywtTPSbi4K4YAO_6iMuCDxTG_b2uPHWwLZKCWUJ5eeSLJywna3tDl6sXENnXP4jIczTsi_EJFVqqF2L4YNQZOyhGb5zBeJ7zX2Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX-Bw0kt975G-suK8eECX2ZontXP4kJTcJQuY6Zl4_Bqx1asz_M9vmP-aPxbXKMO4veesPQkq6zkUaOiKO5bhTcXf0Nxl1FN_kNVG0qucLWBiR52sNSsM3PGy5UefyyWa8BZYowUFu)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF15LTJ8aVne-62r13KxpzUo5egr0iMcHTKMa5iJ3GBWSc3UfY_XHsDBhDuIHi84XCybRh5qI47meuq-sKVg4Q-vIP2xXHiADvc5ij-LY6gnRno2Yvrf4XpY7V7-ztXA0yVuNUwHJHiKik-cpRLtzN6WZOYiD1V534D4b4rVDCtiwd5g1aRShiF0HEV4R2mPLhIzd-Wp9RQh8xgQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXz6VT_NKOWWvfpfYkiIebQlJ895xOA28GOLpEryCLg17kOBrjRa6t9AiAZvnlE2mDcx0Qo9HcvkRPI1_reOzbry5CJEE5GzscJPIdqTmZnrSOFVwtlji816qtoJvIqUTVVm0qp4i4)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF11ORnv_o0fCiSAjzYfVE3vTxdzyNGLLVyNwLOyuCHCLFw5X_f7hSKn2u80PJ6Uy-yGnsRJFqMJXL0Je_JY63nJ0hfINesZ4zigLSchq1xWUZCF7oRIYYMCTnndGf8ZWHbs6teaXGi-wlpIsMgRcpifY9zqHYS8xSkljKj2ouG-L943OqBsBOE7JPVprsSF3g5zb_-JI)
